reason: A chat UI plugin that renders Mermaid code blocks into preview images, primarily using a local renderer with an optional configured fallback server.

summaries.zh: 在聊天界面中将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为可预览、可展开的图像，并支持本地渲染及可选的备用渲染服务器。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks as expandable image previews in chat, using local rendering with an optional configured fallback server.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid fenced code blocks as diagram images
Displays diagrams as expandable thumbnails in chat
Provides runtime settings through the plugin UI
Optionally uses a configured external or self-hosted rendering server as fallback
